gian.A: Same soft hand-painted storybook style, same round gold-rimmed medallion and same chibi proportions as the reference, but the person is now a young CONSORT (imperial concubine) of the inner palace, a graceful woman about twenty-two with a soft pretty face, black hair in a neat elegant bun with two gold hairpins, a small pearl hair ornament and one small pink flower (no crown, no phoenix), a jade green (#6FAE92) silk robe with an ivory (#F1E6D2) collar and light gold embroidery at the shoulders. The medallion disc is now strong red instead of red. Her face and pose: furious red face, brows sharply down, mouth open in an angry shout, one palm slammed flat on the gold rim, the other hand pointing sharply forward, a red anger mark and two small steam puffs. Clear readable action: the slam and the pointing finger clearly visible, exactly two hands, arms kept inside the medallion. Both eyes looking together. Everything kept INSIDE the round medallion, the medallion drawn a bit smaller and centred so there is empty space around it. Bare earlobes, no earrings. Whole picture on a flat pure chroma green (#00FF00) background outside the medallion, nothing else, no text.
gian.B: Same young consort, same soft hand-painted storybook style, same elegant black bun with two gold hairpins, small pearl ornament and small pink flower, same jade green (#6FAE92) silk robe with ivory (#F1E6D2) collar, same round gold-rimmed strong red medallion as the reference. NEW: she is FURIOUS and leans OUT of the round medallion toward the viewer: her head and shoulders come forward over the gold rim, her hands overlap the gold ring; a clear readable action, no big arms, arms stay inside the picture, exactly two hands, no extra hands; one palm slamming flat down on the gold rim, the other hand pointing sharply forward at the viewer, scolding; red face, brows sharply down, mouth open shouting; a red anger mark and two small steam puffs by her hairpins. Wide jade green sleeves visible. Both eyes looking together. The medallion stays round and centred, a bit smaller, with her popping slightly out of it. Bare earlobes, no earrings. Whole picture on a flat pure chroma green (#00FF00) background, nothing else, no text.
gian.out: Hand-painted storybook animation, static camera, flat chroma green background stays perfectly flat green the whole time. The young consort with the gold hairpins inside the round gold medallion flares up in anger: she leans forward over the gold rim, slams one palm flat down on the rim, points sharply forward with the other hand and shouts with a red face, an anger mark and two steam puffs pop up; she comes out of the round frame toward the viewer. Clear readable action, exactly two hands, arms stay inside the picture, the medallion keeps exactly its same size and colour. Smooth, cartoon-like, same painted style, no camera move, no new objects.
gian.loop: Hand-painted storybook animation, static camera, flat chroma green background stays perfectly flat green. The young consort with the gold hairpins leaning out of the round gold medallion keeps scolding furiously in a loop: she slams her palm on the rim again, jabs her pointing finger forward twice, shouts with brows sharply down, the steam puffs puff; then she settles back to exactly the starting pose. Clear readable action, exactly two hands, the medallion keeps exactly its same size and colour. Slow enough to read, cartoon-like, same painted style, no camera move, no new objects.
